offer.text: My child is gone — wandered off days ago and never came back. They loved the forest. Please, search the woods for any trace of them. I'm out of my mind with worry.

accept.text: Bless you. Look where the trees grow thick — that's where they'd go.

decline.text: Then who will look, if not you? Please, reconsider.

in_progress.text: Have you reached the forest? Any sign at all?

ready.text: You searched the woods? Tell me — tell me you found something.

complete.text: Footprints, heading deeper. They were alive when they passed here. There's still hope — we have to follow it.
